data.overall: The answer is mostly faithful to the context. It handles UNKNOWN criteria carefully, reads the deadlines correctly (S207 open, S178 passed) and describes funding accurately (partial, stipend). The one gap is that it omits the University of Montana's requirement to be enrolled at UM.
